condition_notes: Minor blunting/crease on top left corner

valuation.key_issue_notes: First issue of Iron Man (Vol. 2), part of the Heroes Reborn relaunch.
valuation.rarity_notes: Not considered rare due to high print runs typical of major relaunches in the 1990s, but significant for collectors of the Heroes Reborn era.
valuation.analysis_notes: This comic is Iron Man (Vol. 2) #1, published as part of Marvel's 'Heroes Reborn' initiative. This relaunch, which began in 1996, saw several core Marvel characters' continuities rebooted and their origins retold by creators from Image Comics. This specific issue was handled by Jim Lee's WildStorm Productions studio.
